title: Denial of maternity benefits - the legal remedies for women employees
p1:
A woman employee is denied maternity benefits and told, “the company policy does not allow it.”

But can an internal policy override a legal right? The answer may surprise many working women.
p2: Many employees believe maternity benefits depend only on the employer’s approval. In reality, maternity protection laws create specific rights for eligible women employees, and denial of these benefits can be challenged through legal remedies.
p3:
A woman facing denial can seek relief by approaching the appropriate labour authorities or legal forums, depending on the situation. The key is to keep records of employment, communication with the employer, and the reason given for denial.

A simple step many overlook: never rely only on verbal discussions. Written proof can make a significant difference when asserting workplace rights.
